items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...R-O-N-N from Stan Lewis in Shriftpool. [INTERVIEWEE] Right. Okay, yeah, I did this tune for Bob Robin.

ctx.x: Love it. But anyway, this is Bob Robin thing here. And I did another tune with Bob Robin. I did a thing about, well, anyway, I have a tape on it. The record never came out, but it was a heck of a blues thing. In fact, we never did go back to finish it. And I also did another tune I did in the same old way with Bob Robin. And it came out on a, in fact, I got it sitting right over there. If you want to reach my pile of records, because I can't move. I keep talking about you. See that? Is that my records there?…
All of those are mine, too. Oh, yeah, that's Cosmo there. But anyway. Yeah, R-O-N-N from Stan Lewis in Shriftpool.
Right. Okay, yeah, I did this tune for Bob Robin.
